title: Make seamless: a new Image workspace tool that makes any picture tile left-right, top-bottom or both, with the model the user picks
description: Design approved by Fabio 2026-10-12 (record: research/brainstorm.md). A Make seamless FLOW (not a workspace tool): 01 Inputs (optional picture; none = Klein makes one from the prompt first, direction select) - 02 Edges (four % handles, 10% default, Tiles preview slider, Even out lighting slider) - 03 Generate (Tiles slider 1-4: strip / column / per-side grid). The app rolls the picture by half, repaints the band round each seam in ~1024 windows (one model, Klein 9B unless the bench says Krea 2), stitches and rolls back; outside the band byte-identical at full size; no new ComfyUI nodes. Baked instruction + optional prompt field. Bench in research/bench waits for Fabio's GPU go.
